title: Left Front Heated Seat Button
desc: The LF heated seat button will allow the customer to change the state of the left front heated seat from Off to a High heat to a Low heat.

title: Left Front Heated Seat
desc:
HW supplier shall notify the HU wake-up event via the BH-CAN bus through the VHAL interface and provide the HeatedSeatFL signal upon availability and send that to CarPropertyManager via Interface.
CarPropertyManager will expose that value to HMI layer via API interface as get/set methods.
CarPropertyService shall receive the wake-up indication and HeatedSeatFL signal and make them available to the HMI layer.
The HMI layer shall evaluate the received event and signals and initialize the display state.
When the HU wakes up on the BH-CAN bus, the HMI shall display the Front Left heated seat as Off until a valid $HeatedSeatFL$ status is received from CAN.

title: Left Front Heated Seat
desc:
HW supplier shall notify the Heated_Seat_Levels signal via the VHAL interface.
CarPropertyService shall receive the Heated_Seat_Levels signal from VHAL and send that to CarPropertyManager via Interface.
CarPropertyManager will expose that value to HMI layer via API interface as get/set methods.
The HMI layer shall evaluate the received signal and determine the supported heated seat levels.
The HMI shall interpret the Heated_Seat_Levels signal as follows:
If $Heated_Seat_Levels$ = [1], the HMI shall support On/Off only.
If $Heated_Seat_Levels$ = [2], the HMI shall support Off, Low, and High levels.
If $Heated_Seat_Levels$ = [3], the HMI shall support Off, Low, Medium, and High levels.
Any other value of $Heated_Seat_Levels$ shall be considered invalid by the HMI.

title: Left Front Heated Seat
desc:
HW supplier shall notify the HeatedSeatFL signal via the VHAL interface.
CarPropertyService shall receive the HeatedSeatFL signal and and send that to CarPropertyManager via Interface.
CarPropertyManager will expose that value to HMI layer via API interface as get/set methods.
The HMI layer shall evaluate the received signal.
For vehicles supporting two states (i.e. LO and HI), the following values shall be considered valid: $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_OFF], $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_LO], and $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_HI].
The HMI shall interpret the HeatedSeatFL signal as follows:
If $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_OFF], the heated seat shall be considered Off.
If $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_LO], the heated seat shall be considered Low.
If $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_HI], the heated seat shall be considered High.
Any other value of $HeatedSeatFL$ shall be considered invalid by the HMI.

title: Left Front Heated Seat
desc:
HW supplier shall notify the HeatedSeatFL signal via the VHAL interface.
CarPropertyService shall receive the HeatedSeatFL signal and send that to CarPropertyManager via Interface.
CarPropertyManager will expose that value to HMI layer via API interface as get/set methods.
The HMI layer shall evaluate the received signal.
For vehicles supporting three states (i.e. LO, MEDIUM, and HI), the following values shall be considered valid: $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_OFF], $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_LO], $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_MED], and $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_HI].
The HMI shall interpret the HeatedSeatFL signal as follows:
If $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_OFF], the heated seat shall be considered Off.
If $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_LO], the heated seat shall be considered Low.
If $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_MED], the heated seat shall be considered Medium.
If $HeatedSeatFL$ = [HS_HI], the heated seat shall be considered High.
Any other value of $HeatedSeatFL$ shall be considered invalid by the HMI.

title: Left Front Heated Seat
desc:
HW supplier shall notify the HeatedSeatFL signal via the VHAL interface.
CarPropertyService shall receive the HeatedSeatFL signal and and send that to CarPropertyManager via Interface.
CarPropertyManager will expose that value to HMI layer via API interface as get/set methods.
The HMI layer shall evaluate the received signal and compare it with the internally stored status of the LF heated seat.
If the received $HeatedSeatFL$ value is valid and different from the stored value, the HMI shall update the stored status with the new value and update the display to reflect the new state.

title: Heated Steering Wheel
desc:
The HW supplier shall notify the system wake-up and relevant ignition/BH-CAN status signals via the VHAL interface.
CarPropertyService shall receive the wake-up indication from VHAL and forward it to CarPropertyManager via the interface.
CarPropertyManager shall expose the wake-up status to the HMI layer via API interfaces (get/set methods).
The HMI layer shall detect the HU wake-up condition based on the received signals.
Upon HU wake-up on the BH-CAN bus, the HMI shall:
Initialize the Heated Steering Wheel state to OFF
Update the stored state accordingly
Reflect the OFF status on the display (if applicable)

title: Heated Steering Wheel
desc:
The HW supplier shall notify the $Heated_Steering_Levels$ and $HSW_Stat$ signals via the VHAL interface.
CarPropertyService shall receive the $Heated_Steering_Levels$ and $HSW_Stat$ signals from VHAL and forward them to CarPropertyManager via the interface.
CarPropertyManager shall expose the $Heated_Steering_Levels$ and $HSW_Stat$ values to the HMI layer via API interfaces (get/set methods).
The HMI layer shall evaluate the received $Heated_Steering_Levels$ signal to determine the supported Heated Steering Wheel configuration.
When $Heated_Steering_Levels$ = [1_Level], the HMI shall interpret the $HSW_Stat$ signal as follows:
If $HSW_Stat$ = [OFF], the HMI shall:
Set the Heated Steering Wheel state to OFF
Update the display accordingly
If $HSW_Stat$ = [ON], the HMI shall:
Set the Heated Steering Wheel state to ON (HI)
Update the display accordingly
Any other value of $HSW_Stat$ shall be considered invalid by the HMI and handled according to the defined error handling mechanism.

If $HSW_Stat_2$ = [HSW_OFF], the HMI shall:
